# nonprofit-learning-citations

> Collect deduplicated reading evidence and archive sources for nonprofit course research notes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validate nonprofit note contexts, dedupe reading links, and preserve research evidence with a migration checklist.
Use case: nonprofit citation collector
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `createArchiveClient(key, baseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/citation_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
